subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Solving Cable Tangles, Insane Geoguessing, Mind-Bending Documentaries, and When a Forest Becomes an Author

bullets.title: The best way to stop headphone tangles
bullets.note: I’ve gone back to cabled headphones for most things. After losing at least $750 worth of AirPods and having lots of dropped calls and battery-life issues, I’m going retro. The biggest hassle is always the rat’s nest of tangles, and this video provides a short and sweet solution.

bullets.title: o3 Beats a Master-Level Geoguessr Player
bullets.note:
[GeoGuessr](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GeoGuessr) is an online geography game that drops players into random Google Street View scenes and asks them to guess where they are. It became super popular during COVID, and there are ranking systems for human players, who must learn about writing systems, local fauna, and much more… and/or use technology to augment their abilities. If you want to see a spooky-good demo of what good players can do, [check out this 34-second video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2l9kcdxPQ60).  
​  
Last month, OpenAI’s o3 model outscored a Master I–ranked human, correctly naming all five countries and twice landing within just a few hundred meters. You can [read the full post here](https://sampatt.com/blog/2025-04-28-can-o3-beat-a-geoguessr-master) and see the model’s reasoning.

bullets.title: Song of the Cedars
bullets.note:
Past podcast guest [Giuliana Furci](https://tim.blog/2021/07/29/giuliana-furci/?utm_campaign=5bf&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_source=convertkit#content) shared this song with me. Beyond being a lovely and calming listen, as [_The Guardian_](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/25/legal-bid-for-ecuador-forest-to-be-recognised-as-song-co-creator) explains, there is more to the story:  
​  
​_A forest in Ecuador could be recognised as the co-creator of a song under a groundbreaking legal proposal. A petition is to be submitted to Ecuador’s copyright office to recognise the Los Cedros cloud forest as the co-creator of the composition Song of the Cedars. The action by the More Than Human Life (Moth) project is the first legal attempt to recognise an ecosystem’s moral authorship of a work of art. The song contains melodies of echo-locating bats, howler monkeys, rustling leaves and even a subterranean recording of the soil taken from the spot where a new species of fungus was collected and described._  
​  
I highly recommend the listen. Headphones are ideal.

bullets.section: Documentary I just started watching but need to share
bullets.title: 32 Sounds
bullets.note: ([YouTube](https://youtu.be/3t1HMGVMDXY?si=c5x-A6hjqJ-n-VHU), [Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/32-sounds/umc.cmc.1o2h3jsmhb9p4ox42tt5owq0u)). From Oscar-nominated filmmaker [Sam Green](https://samgreen.to/), _32 Sounds_ scores 96% on Rotten Tomatoes. Here’s part of the description: “_32 Sounds_ is an immersive feature documentary and profound sensory experience from Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Sam Green, featuring original music by [JD Samson](https://www.jdsamson.info/). The film explores the elemental phenomenon of sound by weaving together 32 specific sound explorations into a cinematic meditation on the power of sound to bend time, cross borders, and profoundly shape our perception of the world around us.” At the very least, check out the trailer [here](https://www.imdb.com/video/vi4265919257/).
